# base.py

[简体中文](base.zh.md) ｜ **English** ｜ [← Back to README](../../README.en.md)

The Element base class and the helpers shared by every element.

- `_paint`          normalises colour arguments
- `_fmt_points`     formats a point list
- `_fmt_transform`  formats a transform list
- `_num`            converts an attribute value to float (tolerates forms like `"120px"`)
- `Element`         base class of every element: style / transform / animation / z-order /
                    clone / bounding box

---

## Classes and methods

### `Element`

Base class of every element.

| Method | Description |
|---|---|
| `set_opacity(value)` | Set the overall opacity (0-1). |
| `get_opacity()` | Read the current raw opacity attribute (None if never set). |
| `set_fill_opacity(value)` | Set the fill opacity. |
| `get_fill_opacity()` | Read the current raw fill-opacity attribute. |
| `set_stroke_opacity(value)` | Set the stroke opacity. |
| `get_stroke_opacity()` | Read the current raw stroke-opacity attribute. |
| `set_fill_color(color)` | Set the fill colour (ColorName, #RRGGBB or a gradient reference); None removes the fill. |
| `get_fill_color()` | Read the current raw fill attribute. |
| `set_stroke_color(color)` | Set the stroke colour; None removes the stroke. |
| `get_stroke_color()` | Read the current raw stroke attribute. |
| `set_stroke_width(width)` | Set the stroke width; None removes it. |
| `get_stroke_width()` | Read the current raw stroke-width attribute. |
| `set_stroke_style(dash)` | Set the dash pattern, e.g. "6,3". |
| `get_stroke_style()` | Read the current raw stroke-dasharray attribute. |
| `set_dash_offset(offset)` | Set the dash offset (animate a dashed line by shifting it). |
| `get_dash_offset()` | Read the current raw stroke-dashoffset attribute. |
| `set_stroke_cap(cap)` | Set the line cap (butt, round or square). |
| `get_stroke_cap()` | Read the current raw stroke-linecap attribute. |
| `set_stroke_join(join)` | Set the line join (miter, round or bevel). |
| `get_stroke_join()` | Read the current raw stroke-linejoin attribute. |
| `set_fill_rule(rule)` | Set the fill rule; evenodd punches holes in overlapping paths. |
| `get_fill_rule()` | Read the current raw fill-rule attribute. |
| `set_blend_mode(mode)` | Set the blend mode (written into the CSS style). |
| `set_paint_order(order)` | Set the paint order; `PaintOrder.STROKE` draws the stroke first, which outlined/hollow text needs. |
| `get_paint_order()` | Read the current raw paint-order attribute. |
| `set_vector_effect(effect)` | Set the vector effect; non-scaling-stroke keeps the stroke width when scaled. |
| `get_vector_effect()` | Read the current raw vector-effect attribute. |
| `set_class_name(name)` | Set the CSS class name. |
| `get_class_name()` | Read the current raw class attribute. |
| `set_style_str(style)` | Set the inline CSS style string. |
| `get_style_str()` | Read the current raw style attribute. |
| `set_id(id_)` | Set the element id, which get_element(id) can look up later. |
| `set_filter(f, merge=True)` | Attach a filter; calling it again stacks the new effects instead of overwriting the old ones. |
| `get_filter()` | Read the current raw filter attribute, such as `"url(#fx_1)"`; None when there is no filter. |
| `fx_chain(pad=0.4)` | Return the chain bound to this element, creating and binding a new one when there is none. |
| `fx(name, *args, **kwargs)` | Stack any filter effect by name; the generic entry point. |
| `fx_blur(std_deviation=3)` | Stack a Gaussian blur; same as pen.fx.blur. |
| `fx_sharpen(amount=0.5)` | Stack a sharpen pass; same as pen.fx.sharpen. |
| `fx_motion_blur(distance=10, angle=0)` | Stack a motion blur; same as pen.fx.motion_blur. |
| `fx_shadow(dx=4, dy=4, blur=4, color='black', opacity=0.5)` | Stack a drop shadow; same as pen.fx.shadow. |
| `fx_drop_shadow(dx=3, dy=3, std_deviation=3, opacity=0.5)` | Stack a drop shadow with the older parameter names; same as pen.fx.drop_shadow. |
| `fx_inner_shadow(dx=3, dy=3, blur=3, color='black', opacity=0.6)` | Stack an inner shadow; same as pen.fx.inner_shadow. |
| `fx_glow(std_deviation=4, color='#ffb703', opacity=0.9)` | Stack an outer glow; same as pen.fx.glow. |
| `fx_inner_glow(blur=5, color='#ffd166', opacity=0.9)` | Stack an inner glow; same as pen.fx.inner_glow. |
| `fx_bevel(strength=1.0, blur=2, azimuth=225, elevation=55)` | Stack a bevel highlight; same as pen.fx.bevel. |
| `fx_engrave(depth=1.2, blur=1, dark='#3E2410', light='#FFFDF5')` | Stack an engraved, carved-in look; the opposite of the raised fx_bevel, and the same as pen.fx.engrave. |
| `fx_outline(width=3, color='gold')` | Stack an outer stroke; same as pen.fx.outline. |
| `fx_roughen(scale=4, frequency=0.05)` | Stack a roughen pass for a hand-drawn look; same as pen.fx.roughen. |
| `fx_noise(opacity=0.15)` | Stack grain noise; same as pen.fx.noise. |
| `fx_emboss(azimuth=45)` | Stack a grayscale emboss; same as pen.fx.emboss. |
| `fx_edge_detect()` | Stack edge detection for a line-art look; same as pen.fx.edge_detect. |
| `fx_saturate(factor=1.2)` | Stack a saturation change; same as pen.fx.saturate. |
| `fx_hue_rotate(degrees=90)` | Stack a hue rotation; same as pen.fx.hue_rotate. |
| `fx_grayscale()` | Stack a desaturate; same as pen.fx.grayscale. |
| `fx_sepia()` | Stack a sepia tone; same as pen.fx.sepia. |
| `fx_brightness(factor=1.2)` | Stack a brightness change; same as pen.fx.brightness. |
| `fx_contrast(factor=1.3)` | Stack a contrast change; same as pen.fx.contrast. |
| `fx_gamma(r=1.0, g=1.0, b=1.0)` | Stack a gamma correction; same as pen.fx.gamma. |
| `fx_invert()` | Stack an invert; same as pen.fx.invert. |
| `fx_posterize(levels=4)` | Stack a posterize; same as pen.fx.posterize. |
| `fx_color_overlay(color='red', opacity=0.8)` | Stack a color overlay; same as pen.fx.color_overlay. |
| `translate(dx, dy=0)` | Translate the element. |
| `rotate(angle, cx=None, cy=None)` | Rotate the element. |
| `scale(sx, sy=None)` | Scale the element; omitting sy keeps it proportional. |
| `skew_x(angle)` | Shear along the X axis, in degrees. |
| `skew_y(angle)` | Shear along the Y axis, in degrees. |
| `animate_opacity(start=1.0, end=0.0, dur=3, repeat_count='indefinite', begin=0)` | Animate opacity. |
| `animate_translate(offset=(0, 0), dur=3, repeat_count=1, begin=0)` | Animate translation. |
| `animate_rotate(angle=360, center=(0, 0), dur=3, repeat_count='indefinite', begin=0, accelerate=False)` | Animate rotation. |
| `animate_scale(factor=(2, 2), dur=3, repeat_count=1, begin=0)` | Animate scaling. |
| `animate_skew_x(angle=30, dur=3, repeat_count=1, begin=0)` | Animate a shear along the X axis. |
| `animate_skew_y(angle=30, dur=3, repeat_count=1, begin=0)` | Animate a shear along the Y axis. |
| `animate_motion(path, dur=5, rotate=False, repeat_count='indefinite', begin=0)` | Animate movement along a motion path. |
| `animate_dash_flow(dur=2, repeat_count='indefinite', dash='8 4', speed=64)` | Animate marching-ants dashes flowing along the stroke. |
| `remove()` | Remove this element from the canvas. |
| `bring_to_front()` | Bring to front by moving last among siblings. |
| `send_to_back()` | Send to back by moving first among siblings. |
| `change_group(new_parent)` | Move the element into another group. |
| `to_group(id_=None)` | Wrap this element in a new group in place and return the group. |
| `to_template(id_=None, view_box=None)` | Turn this element into a `<symbol>` template in place and return the template. |
| `clone(dx=0, dy=0, id_=None)` | Clone the element, optionally with an offset and a new id. |
| `update(**kw)` | Update only the attributes you pass in; everything else keeps its current value. |
| `bbox()` | Element bounding box as (min_x, min_y, max_x, max_y); None when it cannot be determined. |
| `center_x` (property) | Center x coordinate. |
| `center_y` (property) | Center y coordinate. |
| `width` (property) | Width. |
| `height` (property) | Height. |

## Full example

Run it directly in PyCharm, or from the command line: `python malight/elements/base.py`

```python
if __name__ == "__main__":
    import os

    from malight import Malight, ColorName, Font

    # Output always goes to the project-root output/ directory, wherever you run from
    _out = os.path.abspath(os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__),
                                        "..", "..", "output"))
    pen = Malight(os.path.join(_out, "demo_element_base"), width=560, height=340)
    pen.set_background_color(ColorName.WHITESMOKE)

    pen.text(280, 40, "Element base class: capabilities shared by every element", font=Font.SIMHEI,
             font_size=20, h_align="middle", fill_color=ColorName.NAVY)

    # 1) The board creates elements and returns concrete types, so PyCharm completes them
    ball = pen.circle(140, 170, 60, fill_color=ColorName.TOMATO,
                      stroke_color=ColorName.NAVY, stroke_width=3)
    print("element type:", type(ball).__name__)          # CircleElement

    # 2) Give it an id and you can look it up again
    ball.set_id("ball")
    print("looked up by id, same object:", pen.get_element("ball") is ball)

    # 3) Geometry, provided by the base class for every element
    print("bounding box:", tuple(round(v, 1) for v in ball.bbox()))
    print("centre:", round(ball.center_x, 1), round(ball.center_y, 1))
    print("size:", round(ball.width, 1), round(ball.height, 1))

    # 4) Transforms chain and still return a CircleElement
    ball.translate(20, -10)                  # translate
    ball.rotate(15, cx=140, cy=170)          # rotate around a point
    ball.scale(1.05)                         # scale

    # 5) Partial update: only the keys you pass change, geometry is untouched
    ball.update(opacity=0.85)

    # 6) Filters: one line per effect (pen.fx is the filter factory)
    #    Open the SVG in a browser for filter effects; cairosvg does not render them
    ball.set_filter(pen.fx.shadow(6, 8, 6))

    # 7) Clone: same type, with an optional offset and a new id
    twin = ball.clone(dx=190, id_="ball2")
    print("clone type:", type(twin).__name__,
          "| id:", twin.node.attribs.get("id"))

    # 8) Z-order: later elements sit on top; these change the overlap
    twin.bring_to_front()

    # 9) Animation (SMIL; open the SVG in a browser to see it move)
    twin.animate_translate(offset=(0, -30), dur=2, repeat_count="indefinite")
    twin.animate_opacity(1.0, 0.4, dur=2, repeat_count="indefinite")

    # 10) Pass through custom SVG attributes: keys in extra become attributes
    pen.rect(370, 130, 150, 90, corner_radius=10,
             fill_color=ColorName.STEELBLUE,
             extra={"data-name": "panel"})

    # 11) Remove an element from the canvas
    pen.circle(500, 300, 20, fill_color=ColorName.CRIMSON).remove()

    pen.finish()      # Save the SVG and print the full path, ready to copy


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Bottom import: to_group()'s return annotation names GroupElement, which subclasses
# the Element defined in this module - importing both at the top would cycle; putting it
# at the bottom solves both. elements.__init__ imports base before group, so no cycle.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
from .group import GroupElement  # noqa: E402

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Bottom import (cont.): same idea for to_template()'s TemplateElement annotation.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
from .symbol import TemplateElement  # noqa: E402
```
